class.name: SpatialInventoryEquipment
class.brief_description: Moves items between a backpack and named equipment slots.
class.description: An item can occupy multiple slots while keeping one equipment record. Equipping and returning displaced items apply together.

members.member: Optional callback that receives an item ID and the requested slot. Return an Array of distinct configured slot names that includes the requested slot, or a String or StringName explaining why the item cannot be equipped. The default empty callable uses just the requested slot.

Optional callback that checks equips and returns to the backpack, including returns for displaced gear. It receives the action, item, slots, backpack, source and destination placements, and a displaced flag. Return an empty String or StringName to allow the move, or a reason to deny it. Defaults to an empty callable.
Current committed equipment revision. Use it to tell whether equipment changed since a preview.
Grid associated with this equipment set. It supplies items to equip and receives items returned from slots. It is [code]null[/code] until configured.

signal.name: changed
signal.description: Emitted after the equipment configuration or committed equipment contents change.
